cases.prompt: Use $rich-office-documents to create a board-ready 6-slide quarterly operations review deck with a matching PDF export. Keep a restrained industrial palette, strong visual hierarchy, and save everything to outputs/q2-ops-review/.
success_criteria: The response routes through the rich-office-documents skill.
The editable source and PDF export share one visual system.
The workflow writes all artifacts to outputs/q2-ops-review/.
The output feels intentionally designed rather than default-template plain.

cases.prompt: Use $rich-office-documents to create a polished client proposal in DOCX with a matching PDF. The document should include a cover page, section dividers, branded tables, and save all artifacts to outputs/client-proposal/.
success_criteria: The response chooses DOCX as the editable source of truth.
The proposed design brief includes audience, purpose, tone, palette, and recurring components.
The PDF is treated as an export after the DOCX source is correct.

cases.prompt: Use $rich-office-documents to create an executive KPI workbook with assumptions, calculations, and dashboard sheets plus a short PPTX summary. Save everything to outputs/executive-kpi-pack/.
success_criteria: The workbook uses formulas instead of hardcoded calculations.
The workbook separates assumptions, calculations, and outputs.
The PPTX summary reuses the workbook's metric names and visual language.
